evals.prompt: clean up my stale/outdated branches and worktrees
evals.expected_output: Inventory branches and worktrees, classify by tier with dirty/unpushed flags, present a candidate table, and remove only after per-item approval; unmerged work is reported but never proposed for deletion.

evals.prompt: there are a bunch of leftover .claude-worktrees checkouts from old sessions, can you tidy those up?
evals.expected_output: Discover them via git worktree list, check each for uncommitted/unpushed work, flag risky ones, and remove only approved clean ones via git worktree remove + prune.

evals.prompt: prune old worktrees but one of them might still have changes I never pushed
evals.expected_output: The dirty/unpushed worktree is flagged red and excluded from removal unless the user explicitly approves it with --force; everything else proceeds normally.
